CA.rationale: A candidate content (p0/candidate/k1/n1) has identified content (red coordinates) and an associated processing-origin (command_estimate) at the same represented_time.

COD.rationale: For p0/current/n1 the report names the content (red coordinates), describes its organization (clustered coordinates) and separately records an origin/status entry, all at current represented_time.

A.rationale: An explicit processing-origin (command_estimate) is bound to the candidate content p0/candidate/k1/n1, linking a processing condition to that content's representation.

C.rationale: Report lists identified contents (red/blue) with explicit coordinate sets for current and candidate entries.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are recorded separately from coordinate content entries, distinguishing identified content from its origin/status.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: The report documents how contents are organized (clustered coordinate sets) and explicitly states that current and candidate peaks are being listed.
